prompt.en: The Moon makes its own light.

explanation.en: The Moon reflects light from the Sun; the Sun is the only object here that makes its own light.

prompt.en: Why do we always see the same side of the Moon?

explanation.en: The Moon's spin matches its orbit (synchronous rotation), so one side always faces Earth.

choices: It does not spin at all
It spins once each time it orbits
The far side is always dark

prompt.en: How strong is gravity on the Moon compared with Earth?

explanation.en: Moon gravity is about one sixth of Earth's, so you would weigh much less there.

prompt.en: The Moon is slowly moving away from Earth.

explanation.en: The Moon drifts about 2.5 cm farther from Earth each year.

prompt.en: Starting from New Moon, put these phases in order.

explanation.en: After New Moon the lit part grows (waxes) until we see a Full Moon.

prompt.en: About how long does one full cycle of Moon phases take?

explanation.en: The Moon goes from New Moon back to New Moon in about 29.5 days.

prompt.en: Match each tide word to its meaning.

explanation.en: The Moon's gravity drives tides; when the Sun lines up too we get extra-big spring tides.

choices: Sun and Moon at right angles
Sun, Earth and Moon in a line

questions.kssm: KSSR Sains Tahun 6 Unit 10 Gerhana (prior knowledge)

prompt.en: What happens during a solar eclipse?

explanation.en: In a solar eclipse the Moon blocks some or all of the Sun's light from reaching Earth.

choices: The Moon passes between Sun and Earth
Earth passes between Sun and Moon
The Moon passes behind the Sun

questions.kssm: KSSR Sains Tahun 6 Unit 10 Gerhana (prior knowledge)

prompt.en: A lunar eclipse can only happen at Full Moon.

explanation.en: A lunar eclipse needs Earth exactly between the Sun and Moon, which only happens at Full Moon.

questions.kssm: KSSR Sains Tahun 6 Unit 10 Gerhana (prior knowledge)

prompt.en: Match each type of solar eclipse to what you see.

explanation.en: An annular eclipse happens when the Moon is far from Earth and looks too small to cover the Sun.

choices: A ring of Sun around the Moon
Moon covers part of the Sun

prompt.en: Starting from Full Moon, put these phases in order.

explanation.en: After Full Moon the lit part shrinks (wanes) until New Moon.

questions.kssm: KSSR Sains Tahun 6 Unit 10 Gerhana (prior knowledge)

prompt.en: Why don't we get an eclipse every month?

explanation.en: The Moon's orbit is tilted about 5 degrees, so it usually passes above or below the Sun-Earth line.
